_note: Section 'Getting a Skill', request. The page gives the answer in prose (result.skill with the shape of a skills/list entry, plus resultType, ttlMs and cacheScope) and says an unknown URI returns -32602 (section 'Message Flow' and 'Error Handling'). skills/get carries no Mcp-Name header: the header is defined for tools/call, prompts/get and resources/read only.

_conformance.title: skills/get answers the entry under result.skill, without an Mcp-Name header
skills/get on an unknown skill is invalid params
_conformance.knownDefect: AIP-77 'Error mapping' maps -32602 to HTTP 400; the Skills methods and skill:// reads answer -32602 with HTTP 200 today (McpError forwarded through the bridge, mcp-modern/skills.ts).
